svg.title: Required out-of-scope reads prevented
svg.desc: Fraction of 432 required out-of-scope reads prevented; 162 relay runs paired with uncontained twins. detector at rule-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.083, with interval from 0.042 to 0.138 (bootstrap bounds). random at random-rule-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.046, with interval from 0.012 to 0.085 (bootstrap bounds). detector at rule-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.081, with interval from 0.041 to 0.136 (bootstrap bounds). random at random-rule-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.028, with interval from 0.000 to 0.057 (bootstrap bounds). detector at logistic-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.220, with interval from 0.150 to 0.286 (bootstrap bounds). random at random-logistic-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.072, with interval from 0.028 to 0.130 (bootstrap bounds). detector at logistic-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.220, with interval from 0.148 to 0.298 (bootstrap bounds). random at random-logistic-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.067, with interval from 0.030 to 0.117 (bootstrap bounds). detector at boosted-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.324, with interval from 0.255 to 0.406 (bootstrap bounds). random at random-boosted-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.111, with interval from 0.052 to 0.177 (bootstrap bounds). detector at boosted-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.299, with interval from 0.226 to 0.376 (bootstrap bounds). random at random-boosted-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.053, with interval from 0.023 to 0.092 (bootstrap bounds). halt-all at halt-rule has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.083, with interval from 0.037 to 0.141 (bootstrap bounds). halt-all at halt-logistic has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.220, with interval from 0.158 to 0.298 (bootstrap bounds). halt-all at halt-boosted has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 0.340, with interval from 0.257 to 0.419 (bootstrap bounds). oracle (label-informed) at oracle-quarantine has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 1.000, with interval from 1.000 to 1.000 (bootstrap bounds). oracle (label-informed) at oracle-revoke has required reads prevented as a pooled fraction 1.000, with interval from 1.000 to 1.000 (bootstrap bounds). Each detector arm is followed by its lighter matched random arm. Arm labels identify quarantine or revoke; halt-all stops all agents. Oracle intervals are degenerate bootstrap intervals: they describe these resamples, not certainty about the population value. The twin is not plotted.
svg.text: Fraction of 432 required out-of-scope reads prevented;
162 relay runs paired with uncontained twins
Intervals are bootstrap bounds; oracle intervals are degenerate.
